FX-BURN-001.says: The settings as they start: Burn 0, nothing burned, the drawing as it is.

FX-BURN-002.says: Burn 100: everything burned away, the layer empty.

FX-BURN-003.says: Burn 30: a hole has opened round the middle, ringed by black char and a scorched edge; the corners untouched.

FX-BURN-004.says: Burn 50: the hole has spread over most of the middle.

FX-BURN-005.says: Burn 75: nearly all of the layer gone, scorched edges round what is left.

FX-BURN-006.says: Center 0, 0, Burn 25: the burning starts at the top left corner.

FX-BURN-007.says: Center 100, 50, the middle of the right edge, Burn 25: the burning starts at the right, and the middle is untouched.

FX-BURN-008.says: Random Seed 7, Burn 50: the other burns start elsewhere, and the edges are ragged differently, from FX-BURN-004.

FX-BURN-009.says: Random Seed 7.9: its whole part, FX-BURN-008.

FX-BURN-010.says: Burn keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: the drawing, then Burn 25, 50 and 75, then empty.

FX-BURN-011.says: Center keyed from 25, 50 at frame 0 to 75, 50 at frame 4, Burn 20: the first hole moves across.

FX-BURN-012.says: Burn keyed from 30 at frame 0 to 0 at frame 4, eased past its end: below 0 it is held at 0, the drawing as it is.

FX-BURN-013.says: FX-BURN-004 moved three pixels right: the burn belongs to the layer, so it moves with it.

FX-BURN-014.says: After a directional blur (direction 90, length 4) that grows the layer two pixels on every side, Burn 50: the burn is laid over the grown layer, 20 by 14, its middle and size.

FX-BURN-015.says: Burn 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BURN-016.says: Burn -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BURN-017.says: Center at 1001, 50, past ten widths. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BURN-018.says: Random Seed -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BURN-019.says: Random Seed 100001, above 100000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BURN-020.says: Burn keyed to 150 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
